desc: Precompute `pref[i]` for all `i` from 1 to N, where `pref[i]` is the number of distinct elements in `A[1...i]`.
Precompute `suff[i]` for all `i` from 1 to N, where `suff[i]` is the number of distinct elements in `A[i...N]`.

Initialize a segment tree that supports range addition and range maximum query, storing values `val[i] = pref[i] + mid_distinct[i]`. Initially, `mid_distinct[i] = 0` for all `i`, so `val[i] = pref[i]`.

Iterate `j` from 2 to N-2. For each `j`, update the segment tree: let `p = last_pos[A[j]]`. Perform a range add of 1 on indices `[p, j-1]` in the segment tree (if `p < j`). Update `last_pos[A[j]] = j`.
Query the maximum value in the segment tree for the range `[1, j-1]`. Add `suff[j+1]` to this maximum to get the candidate answer for this `j`.
Track the overall maximum answer across all valid `j` and print it.
